name: Cloudflare One
product_focus: Cloudflare WAN / Magic WAN / Zero Trust
evidence_summary: Cloudflare sources evidence WAN any-to-any connectivity, Magic WAN Connector and Cloudflare One integrated SASE positioning.
cost_model: Quote-based enterprise pricing; some Zero Trust user tiers public, Magic WAN enterprise requires quote.
key_differentiators: Cloudflare global edge network provides one of the largest PoP footprints in the category for SASE traffic.
Strong Zero Trust and SWG capability inheritance from the wider Cloudflare security platform.
Magic WAN Connector provides simplified branch connectivity into the Cloudflare One platform.
best_fit_for: Buyers already using Cloudflare for DDoS protection, CDN or Zero Trust who want to extend into WAN.
Organisations prioritising global PoP coverage and edge performance for SaaS access.
Mid-market buyers attracted to Cloudflare One pricing transparency for Zero Trust user tiers.
watch_outs: SD-WAN capabilities (path selection, QoS, packet loss remediation) have limited public evidence compared to SD-WAN-first vendors.
Less mature for very large branch estates with complex underlay requirements.
Managed and co-managed service models are partner-led; this is primarily a self-service platform.
verification_notes: Re-verified 2026-07-29 against named primary sources. Every graded fact carries a source, a tier and a verbatim quote confirmed present on the cited page by an independent check. Facts that could not be sourced are published as unknown with the reason stated. Sources found and rejected are listed in the evidence register at tier 4.

ai_capability.note: AI assistant and security analytics across the global edge; Workers AI platform adjacency.

resilience.note: Anycast edge across 300+ cities removes single PoP dependency; automatic re-routing.

profile.platform_architecture: Cloudflare One delivers SASE from the same anycast edge that runs Cloudflare's CDN: 330+ cities, every service in every location, with traffic attracted to the nearest PoP and policy applied there. Connectivity options include the WARP agent, Magic WAN for site tunnels and Cloudflare Network Interconnect. There are no Cloudflare branch appliances; Magic WAN partners and standard IPsec/GRE handle site onboarding.
profile.security_sase: Gateway (SWG), Access (ZTNA), CASB, DLP, email security and browser isolation compose the SSE layer, tightly integrated with Cloudflare's DDoS and application security heritage. Access is notably easy to adopt app by app. Depth in enterprise DLP and CASB trails the specialist leaders, while network-adjacent security (DDoS, WAF, bot management) is far beyond what SASE rivals carry.
profile.service_support_channel: Self-serve to enterprise sales motions, with UK partners growing; managed offers exist though carrier-style wrap is thinner than for appliance vendors. Deployment is fast and developer-friendly with excellent documentation. Enterprise support runs 24x7 with named contacts on larger contracts.
profile.commercials_verdict: Per-user Zero Trust plans with transparent public entry pricing and contract pricing at enterprise; Magic WAN priced separately. The Netify verdict: shortlist Cloudflare One when you already trust Cloudflare for performance or security, when fast app-by-app ZTNA adoption appeals, or when global edge reach per pound matters. Heavy CASB/DLP programmes and appliance-led branch estates fit other platforms better.

vendor_faqs.q: Can Cloudflare One replace my VPN quickly?
vendor_faqs.a: Yes, that is its strongest entry point: Cloudflare Access publishes internal apps behind zero trust authentication app by app, often within days, without re-architecting the network first. Full SASE adoption can then proceed incrementally.

vendor_faqs.q: How do sites connect without Cloudflare appliances?
vendor_faqs.a: Magic WAN terminates standard IPsec or GRE tunnels from existing routers, SD-WAN edges or firewalls, and Cloudflare Network Interconnect offers private peering. Cloudflare partners with SD-WAN vendors rather than shipping edges.

vendor_faqs.q: Is Cloudflare One enterprise-ready for compliance-heavy estates?
vendor_faqs.a: Certifications and regional controls have matured substantially, and the edge offers strong data localisation suites. Deep DLP and CASB programmes should still benchmark against Netskope and Zscaler before committing.

shortlist_summary: Cloudflare One provide one of the largest PoP footprints in the category for SASE traffic via the Cloudflare global edge network, with deployment in hours reflecting a lightweight, agentless onboarding model. Typically shortlisted by organisations prioritising Zero Trust network access and cloud-first security rather than branch WAN replacement: the platform scores more strongly on SSE and ZTNA than on traditional SD-WAN appliance functionality.
cost_note: Transparent per-user pricing with a public entry tier; competitive for Zero Trust adoption.
uk_basis: No UK HQ (US). Multiple UK edge locations; self-serve or via UK partners.

f01_fully_managed_service.quote: Cloudflare authorized service delivery partners have a strong track record of delivering excellent customer experiences and in-depth knowledge of our services to customers.
f01_fully_managed_service.note: Cloudflare sells Cloudflare One as a self-administered cloud platform. No page read describes Cloudflare designing, operating, changing and reporting on the service end to end for the customer; ongoing delivery is positioned through authorised service delivery partners. Pages read: sase, professional services, partners/services, partners/managed-service-providers.

f03_co_managed_service.quote: a Cloudflare solution SME works alongside your team to guide configuration with proven best practices
f03_co_managed_service.note: Evidence supports shared working during configuration through Quickstart advisory services. No evidence found of an ongoing co-managed operating model with a formal split of retained customer change rights.

f04_multi_tenant_msp_white_label_support.quote: The Cloudflare Tenant API is a provisioning mechanism to help Channel and Alliance partners set up and manage Cloudflare accounts and services for their customers.
f04_multi_tenant_msp_white_label_support.note: The Tenant Platform gives partners per-customer account provisioning and delegated administration, which covers tenant isolation. No evidence found on the pages read of branded portals or white-label templates letting an MSP operate the platform under its own brand.

f05_professional_services_and_migration_.quote: For deployments with complex or unique requirements, Cloudflare architects and consultants are available to help you manage your implementation end-to-end.
f05_professional_services_and_migration_.note: Two structured tiers are published, Quickstart advisory and Expert services, covering project planning, architectural design, test validation and hands-on support, delivered by Cloudflare directly or by authorised service delivery partners. Explicit migration runbook and rollback wording was not found in the main body text.

f07_lifecycle_management.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The Cloudflare One Appliance documentation states it is managed remotely through the dashboard, but no statement was found covering firmware upgrades, patching, hardware replacement or RMA, renewals or end-of-life planning as part of the service. Pages read: the connector documentation index and the maintenance documentation index; the connector hardware reference URL returned 404.

f17_cellular_and_5g_support.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. No mention of 4G, 5G, LTE, modems or SIM management appears on the Cloudflare WAN product page, the Cloudflare One Appliance documentation or its maintenance index. The connector hardware specification URL returned 404 and web search was unavailable to locate an alternative page.

f19_public_cloud_gateways.quote: Instead of backhauling traffic through a central data center or maintaining dedicated MPLS circuits at every site, your traffic routes through the nearest Cloudflare data center where security policies apply inline.
f19_public_cloud_gateways.note: The enforcement points are Cloudflare's own data centres, not a third party's infrastructure that Cloudflare resells. The SASE page states Cloudflare delivers full SASE from 300+ cities and the network page states 337 cities and 8 regions.

f20_private_pops_dedicated_pops.quote: Choose the location of the data centers where your traffic is inspected.
f20_private_pops_dedicated_pops.note: The Data Localization Suite offers regional control over which of Cloudflare's own data centres inspect traffic, which addresses sovereignty of the processing location. That remains region selection inside the shared multi-tenant network. No offer of customer-hosted or physically dedicated PoPs was found on the pages read.

f21_private_global_backbone.quote: Our backbone is a dedicated network, providing guaranteed network capacity and consistent latency between various locations.
f21_private_global_backbone.note: The same dated vendor post states the backbone comprises long-distance fibre optic cables connecting Cloudflare data centres across North America, South America, Europe and Asia, so it is intercontinental rather than national. Evidence is from a 2021 post; the SASE reference architecture read in 2026 does not use the word backbone.

f26_sla_backed_service_fabric.quote: backed by dependable SLAs, 100% uptime, and reliable service you can trust.
f26_sla_backed_service_fabric.note: Availability and 24/7/365 support commitments are published for Enterprise plans. The underlying contractual SLA document itself was not reachable, as two candidate SLA URLs returned 404, so change handling and latency, jitter and loss commitments could not be verified.

f27_integrated_next_generation_firewall.quote: Cloudflare One converges core SASE services such as zero trust network access (ZTNA), secure web gateway (SWG), cloud access security broker (CASB), network-as-a-service (NaaS), and firewall-as-a-service (FWaaS).
f27_integrated_next_generation_firewall.note: Firewall, secure web gateway and DLP are converged into Cloudflare's own platform and delivered from its network rather than as a separate appliance or a resold third-party stack. Gateway documentation confirms packet-level network policies and full inspection of web request content. Intrusion prevention specifically was not confirmed by a verbatim sentence on the pages read.

f40_managed_service_assurance.quote: Award-winning, global, 24/7/365 email and emergency phone support (for Enterprise plans).
f40_managed_service_assurance.note: Round the clock vendor support is published, but no statement was found describing a NOC and SOC proactively monitoring the customer service, owning incidents through to root cause analysis, or running structured service reviews and change governance.

delivery_model.quote: Cloudflare One converges core SASE services such as zero trust network access (ZTNA), secure web gateway (SWG), cloud access security broker (CASB), network-as-a-service (NaaS), and firewall-as-a-service (FWaaS).
delivery_model.note: Cloudflare authors and operates the Cloudflare One platform itself and sells it as a subscription product. Ongoing managed operation for customers is described as available through authorised service delivery partners rather than as a Cloudflare-run managed service, so it grades as a technology vendor rather than both.

underlay_ownership.quote: We began building out our global backbone in 2018. It comprises a network of long-distance fiber optic cables connecting various Cloudflare data centers across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia.
underlay_ownership.note: Cloudflare owns its inter-data-centre backbone fibre and its core routing, and offers private Cloudflare Network Interconnect. Site access is customer supplied, since locations reach Cloudflare over IPsec or GRE tunnels across whatever internet transport the customer holds. No evidence found that Cloudflare sells last-mile access circuits.

sse_layer_ownership.quote: Cloudflare One converges core SASE services such as zero trust network access (ZTNA), secure web gateway (SWG), cloud access security broker (CASB), network-as-a-service (NaaS), and firewall-as-a-service (FWaaS).
sse_layer_ownership.note: ZTNA, SWG, CASB, DLP and FWaaS are Cloudflare's own software running in Cloudflare's own data centres. No third-party security vendor is named anywhere on the pages read as supplying the SSE stack.

regulatory_documentation.quote: Explore our posture around ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, SOC 2 Type II, and others
regulatory_documentation.note: Named on the Trust Hub: ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS and SOC 2 Type II. GDPR appears in navigation and on the data localization page. Not found on the pages read: NHS DSPT, DORA, NIS2 and FedRAMP. The compliance resources page names no frameworks and routes users to dashboard downloads.

pop_count.quote: Cloudflare delivers full SASE from 300+ cities
pop_count.note: Cloudflare publishes city counts rather than a PoP count. The SASE page states 300+ cities; the network page states 337 cities and 8 regions, plus 13,000+ network interconnections. Both vendor figures are recorded in conflicts.

sla_availability_pct.quote: backed by dependable SLAs, 100% uptime, and reliable service you can trust.
sla_availability_pct.note: The 100% uptime figure is published on the Enterprise plan page and is tied to Enterprise plans only. The underlying SLA contract with service credit mechanics was not reachable, as two candidate SLA URLs returned 404. No separate availability percentage specific to Cloudflare One or Magic Transit was found.
